title: Gripper, in particular pneumatically operated gripper in the form of a vacuum gripper or gripping tongs

features.item: A housing with a grip portion for gripping and an electrically operated vacuum generating device
features.quote: The present invention relates to a gripper ( 100 ) and in particular a pneumatically operated gripper ( 100 ) in the form of a vacuum gripper or gripping tongs.
features.note: The reference discloses a gripper that can be a vacuum gripper and is pneumatically operated, but does not specify an electrically operated vacuum generating device.

features.item: The grip portion is a hollow body
features.note: The reference describes a suction cup as a gripping member which is a hollow body, but does not describe the grip portion (gripper holder) as a hollow body.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device is guided through the grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum source connected to a suction area, but does not mention exhaust air being guided through a grip portion.

features.item: A sound-damping device is arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-damping device.

features.note: The reference describes a gripper with a gripper holder and a gripping member, which can be a vacuum gripper, but does not disclose a hollow grip portion, an electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routing through the grip, or a sound-damping device.

claims.quote: The present invention relates to a gripper, in particular a pneumatically operated gripper in the form of a vacuum gripper or gripping tongs.
claims.note: The reference discloses a vacuum gripper, but not specifically a 'grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device and for use with a suction plate'.

The reference describes various types of grippers, but the specific 'grip unit according to claim 1' from the subject invention is not present in this reference.
